info.title: Crockery Commerce API
info.description:
Backend for a crockery, glassware, kitchenware and home-decor store.

* All money values are **integer paise** (₹1 = 100).
* Cookie-authenticated unsafe requests need the `X-CSRF-Token` header (from `GET /api/v1/auth/csrf`).
* Responses use the envelope `{ success, message, data, meta }`.

Upload storefront media. Files are validated by decoding (not by MIME type), stripped of EXIF, re-encoded and stored PRIVATELY with status pending_review; they get public URLs only after approval. Optional targetId links the upload to the record it is meant for; replaces=<uploadId> uploads a replacement (for a product image: staged until published).
